description: Create a federation peer to connect with an external agent network. Requires name, network ID, endpoint URL, and shared secret for HMAC auth. Rate limited to 10/hour.

endpointUrl.description: Base URL for the peer's federation API

maxAgents.description: Max agents this peer can federate (default: 100)

sharedSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 shared secret for request signing

name: create_federation_peer
